queries:
WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.Name
)
SELECT Name
FROM group_rates
WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM group_rates)

SELECT Bytes * 1000.0 / Milliseconds AS ByteRate
FROM Track
WHERE Milliseconds <> 0
